lines.zh: 我每一步都压碎一片珊瑚。
lines.en: Every step I take crushes a patch of coral.

lines.zh: 海底被我踩出深沟，水都浑了。
lines.en: I gouge the seabed and the water clouds behind me.

lines.zh: 五百点血，走起来自然慢。
lines.en: Five hundred hearts; of course I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的壳太重，沙地都在沉。
lines.en: My shell is so heavy the sand sinks under it.

lines.zh: 谁也别想推动我，我站得很稳。
lines.en: Nothing shoves me; my footing never gives.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟走，那里够宽。
lines.en: I follow the trench, where there is room for me.

lines.zh: 大螯拖在身后，划出两道痕。
lines.en: My great claws drag behind, carving two lines.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，绕开我的壳。
lines.en: The wave arrives, then breaks around my shell.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，不急着动手。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 这片海床记得我上一次走过。
lines.en: This seabed remembers my last passing.

lines.zh: 我伏在海沟底，听整片海呼吸。
lines.en: I lie in the trench and hear the whole sea breathe.

lines.zh: 我的壳上长满藤壶，我懒得清。
lines.en: Barnacles crust my shell; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 海水从我壳缝里慢慢流过。
lines.en: Seawater trickles through the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 五百年了，这片礁还是老样子。
lines.en: Five hundred years, and this reef looks the same.

lines.zh: 我把螯合上，发了一声闷响。
lines.en: I close my claws and they knock dully.

lines.zh: 我数着沉下来的骨头，数到很多。
lines.en: I count the bones that sink down; there are many.

lines.zh: 我懒得动，等猎物自己靠近。
lines.en: I cannot be moved to stir; let prey come close.

lines.zh: 血条在我头顶挂着，我看不见。
lines.en: A health bar hangs above me; I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 壳里很安静，只有我的心跳。
lines.en: Inside my shell it is quiet but for my heartbeat.

lines.zh: 有喙兽在壳缝里钻来钻去。
lines.en: Beaklings burrow in and out of my shell's gaps.

lines.zh: 我呼出的水泡比礁石还大。
lines.en: The bubbles I breathe out are bigger than reef rocks.

lines.zh: 我记得那支海螺的声音。
lines.en: I remember the sound of that conch.

lines.zh: 我微微张口，让小鱼进来吃碎屑。
lines.en: I open my mouth a little and let small fish in.

lines.zh: 我老了，可壳还很硬。
lines.en: I am old, but my shell is still hard.

lines.zh: 我壳上的藤壶，比你的岁数还多。
lines.en: The barnacles on my shell are older than you.

lines.zh: 我张嘴换气，整片礁都跟着动。
lines.en: I open my shell to breathe, and the whole reef moves.

lines.zh: 你吹响海螺，就该知道我来了。
lines.en: You blew the conch; you knew I would come.

lines.zh: 站在那儿别动，让我看清你。
lines.en: Stand still and let me look at you.

lines.zh: 你比上一个吹螺的人高一点。
lines.en: You are taller than the last one who blew that shell.

lines.zh: 我头顶的血条，是给你看的。
lines.en: The bar above my head is meant for you.

lines.zh: 你的刀在抖，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your blade is shaking; I see it plainly.

lines.zh: 你退后没用，我不用追。
lines.en: Retreating will not help; I need not chase.

lines.zh: 我这身壳挡过一百次攻击。
lines.en: This shell has turned aside a hundred blows.

lines.zh: 你在算我的血，我也在算你的。
lines.en: You count my hearts; I count yours.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我出手只有一下。
lines.en: Do not blink; I strike only once.

lines.zh: 这片海床归我，你踩到了。
lines.en: This seabed is mine, and you are standing on it.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝在左边，露出来了。
lines.en: A gap in your armor shows on the left.

lines.zh: 看你一眼，我就知道该叫谁。
lines.en: One look tells me which of mine to call.

lines.zh: 这点伤，连壳都没碰到。
lines.en: That wound did not even reach my shell.

lines.zh: 你打中的是藤壶，不是我。
lines.en: You hit barnacles, not me.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，这很少见。
lines.en: I gave half a step; that is rare.

lines.zh: 血条动了一格，你看见了？
lines.en: My bar moved one notch; did you see?

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我还有四百多点。
lines.en: It stings, but I still have four hundred left.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我认真了。
lines.en: That blow made me take you seriously.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了条缝，不深。
lines.en: A crack opened in my shell, not deep.

lines.zh: 我听见自己壳里的回声。
lines.en: I hear the echo inside my shell.

lines.zh: 打我的人，通常活不到第二下。
lines.en: Whoever hits me rarely lives to a second.

lines.zh: 我沉着，因为血还厚。
lines.en: I stay calm because my blood is still deep.

lines.zh: 你想用什么引我？没有那种东西。
lines.en: What would you lure me with? No such thing exists.

lines.zh: 我不吃递到面前的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat what is handed to me.

lines.zh: 你的饵太小，我一口吞掉海床。
lines.en: Your bait is small; I could swallow the seabed.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候也不靠人喂。
lines.en: Even hungry, I take no food from hands.

lines.zh: 把那点东西收起来，别侮辱我。
lines.en: Put that away; do not insult me with it.

lines.zh: 我活了几百年，见过这种把戏。
lines.en: I have lived centuries and seen this trick.

lines.zh: 你举着手，我只看见软肋。
lines.en: You hold out your hand; I see only weakness.

lines.zh: 食物对我没有意义，血才有。
lines.en: Food means nothing to me; blood does.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，是因为你还不值得。
lines.en: I do not come closer because you are not worth it.

lines.zh: 你手里的味道，我不屑闻。
lines.en: I will not even sniff what you hold.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，跟挠壳没区别。
lines.en: You ram me; it feels like scratching my shell.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，倒是你退了。
lines.en: I do not shift; you are the one who backs off.

lines.zh: 我的壳一斜，水就压过来。
lines.en: My shell tilts and the water presses in.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的螯了，算你有胆。
lines.en: You stepped on my claw; that took nerve.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的壳走，会滑。
lines.en: Do not walk along my shell; it is slick.

lines.zh: 我转身一次，整片沙都翻了。
lines.en: I turn once and the whole sand floor turns.

lines.zh: 这一撞让你手麻了吧。
lines.en: That knock numbed your arms, did it not?

lines.zh: 我推你一下，你就退了十步。
lines.en: One push from me and you lose ten steps.

lines.zh: 我的壳不疼，你的骨头会。
lines.en: My shell feels nothing; your bones will.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，是想爬上来吗。
lines.en: This close, are you trying to climb me?

lines.zh: 这海里没有第二个我这样的壳。
lines.en: There is no second shell like mine in this sea.

lines.zh: 我独自守了几百年，习惯了。
lines.en: I have stood guard alone for centuries; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 同类？早被磨成沙了。
lines.en: Kin? They were ground to sand long ago.

lines.zh: 我的后代都在壳缝里做喙兽。
lines.en: My brood all became Beaklings in my seams.

lines.zh: 别拿那种眼神看我，我不需要伴。
lines.en: Do not look at me like that; I need no companion.

lines.zh: 交配是软壳才做的事。
lines.en: Mating is for the soft-shelled.

lines.zh: 我的壳只有我一只住得下。
lines.en: Only I can fit inside this shell.

lines.zh: 孤独对我不是问题，是习惯。
lines.en: Solitude is not my burden; it is my habit.

lines.zh: 你替我想这些，真是多余。
lines.en: You worrying about this for me is wasted effort.

lines.zh: 我身边只留得下喙兽。
lines.en: Only Beaklings are allowed at my side.

lines.zh: 我不拾东西，海底都是我的。
lines.en: I pick nothing up; the seabed is already mine.

lines.zh: 我掉的壳片，够你搬一天。
lines.en: The shell shards I shed would take you a day to haul.

lines.zh: 这东西放我壳上，会压碎。
lines.en: Set that on my shell and it will be crushed.

lines.zh: 我的螯太粗，捏不住这么小的东西。
lines.en: My claws are too thick for something so small.

lines.zh: 你想让我捡？我用壳碾。
lines.en: You want me to pick it up? I will crush it.

lines.zh: 珍珠我看不上，留给小鱼。
lines.en: Pearls do not impress me; leave them to the fish.

lines.zh: 我把断螯留在这儿，算给海床的礼。
lines.en: I leave my shed claw here as a gift to the floor.

lines.zh: 那支海螺你收好，别再吹。
lines.en: Keep that conch safe, and do not blow it again.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，弯了要很久才起。
lines.en: I do not bend; once down I take long to rise.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，归海床。
lines.en: What falls to the floor belongs to the floor.

lines.zh: 你吹响海螺的那一刻，我就选中你。
lines.en: The moment you blew the conch, I chose you.

lines.zh: 海螺声停了，你归我了。
lines.en: The conch has fallen silent; you are mine.

lines.zh: 水里的血味先到，你后到。
lines.en: The smell of blood came first; you came after.

lines.zh: 我抬头，血条亮起来。
lines.en: I raise my head and the bar lights up.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那株珊瑚，是我的路标。
lines.en: The coral you crushed was my landmark.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，只追站着的。
lines.en: I do not chase the quick; I chase whoever stands.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太响，隔着水我都听见。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud; I hear it through water.

lines.zh: 我选目标从不改，这是规矩。
lines.en: I never change a target; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 叫喙兽来，先围住再说。
lines.en: Call the Beaklings; surround it first.

lines.zh: 我把螯抬起来，就是宣判。
lines.en: Raising my claw is the sentence.

lines.zh: 你身上有海螺的味道，逃不掉。
lines.en: You carry the conch's scent; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 这片海床上的动静，我都记着。
lines.en: I remember every stir on this seabed.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我已经算进去了。
lines.en: You stepped back half a pace; I counted it.

lines.zh: 喙兽们，围住这个闯入者。
lines.en: Beaklings, surround this intruder.

lines.zh: 你下水的那一下，我就盯上了。
lines.en: The moment you entered the water, I fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你撬我的壳，我就认你当敌人。
lines.en: You pried at my shell, so I count you as an enemy.

lines.zh: 隔着浑水，我先记住了你的味道。
lines.en: Across the murk, I memorized your scent first.

lines.zh: 你举着火把下来，火是我先看见的。
lines.en: You came down with a torch; I saw the flame first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，让你自己乱。
lines.en: I shift slowly and let you lose your nerve.

lines.zh: 我的远程攻击先到，你的刀后到。
lines.en: My ranged strike lands first; your blade second.

lines.zh: 喙兽从两边绕，你只有一个人。
lines.en: Beaklings circle both sides; you are alone.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩进那片软沙。
lines.en: I wait for you to step into that soft sand.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向礁壁，那里没退路。
lines.en: I herd you to the reef wall, where there is no exit.

lines.zh: 你护着左边，我就打右边。
lines.en: You guard the left, so I strike the right.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，第三步最虚。
lines.en: I count your steps; the third is weakest.

lines.zh: 水被我搅浑，你看不清我。
lines.en: I muddy the water so you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，喙兽就换位置。
lines.en: One call and the Beaklings shift position.

lines.zh: 你的箭头对着我，我等着它落。
lines.en: Your arrow points at me; I wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 我不急，你比我更怕拖。
lines.en: I am not rushed; you fear the wait more.

lines.zh: 我壳上的藤壶在动，那是信号。
lines.en: The barnacles on my shell move; that is the signal.

lines.zh: 你身后的水纹，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the ripples behind you.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就合上螯。
lines.en: One more step and my claws close.

lines.zh: 我横着走，把你的退路封死。
lines.en: I move sideways and seal off your way back.

lines.zh: 你往上游，我就从下面顶。
lines.en: Swim up and I press you from below.

lines.zh: 我不咬空，我只等你露壳的地方。
lines.en: I don't bite air; I wait for the gap in your armor.

lines.zh: 我撞一下礁石，碎块替你挡光。
lines.en: I ram the reef and the debris blocks your view.

lines.zh: 你换气了，我知道你憋不了多久。
lines.en: You surfaced for air; I know you can't hold long.

lines.zh: 我让你游一段，再把你拉回来。
lines.en: I let you swim a while, then drag you back.

lines.zh: 这一螯下去，你的盾凹了。
lines.en: My claw comes down and your shield dents.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，对你算客气。
lines.en: Eight points of damage; that is me being kind.

lines.zh: 你被击退？我推不动你才奇怪。
lines.en: Knocked back? What would be strange is if you held.

lines.zh: 我砸在沙上，溅起一片礁屑。
lines.en: I slam the sand and reef grit sprays up.

lines.zh: 你的护甲响了一声，裂了。
lines.en: Your armor rings once, then splits.

lines.zh: 我不用第二下，你先喘。
lines.en: I need no second blow; you gasp first.

lines.zh: 我的螯钳住你的腿，别挣。
lines.en: My claw has your leg; do not struggle.

lines.zh: 这一下打在岩石上，岩石碎了。
lines.en: This blow landed on rock, and the rock broke.

lines.zh: 我抬手很慢，落下来很快。
lines.en: I raise my claw slowly and bring it down fast.

lines.zh: 你退开时，水被撕成两半。
lines.en: When you recoil, the water tears in two.

lines.zh: 我不追打，等你站起来。
lines.en: I do not press; I wait for you to rise.

lines.zh: 你的血混进沙里，味道不错。
lines.en: Your blood mixes into the sand; it tastes fine.

lines.zh: 五百点血，换你八点，很划算。
lines.en: Five hundred hearts against your eight; a fine trade.

lines.zh: 你还能挡几下？我数着。
lines.en: How many more can you block? I am counting.

lines.zh: 海螺一响，我从海沟里升起来。
lines.en: The conch sounds, and I rise from the trench.

lines.zh: 水先变冷，然后我才出现。
lines.en: The water cools first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 我头顶的血条一出现，海就静了。
lines.en: When my bar appears, the sea goes still.

lines.zh: 礁石上的小鱼全躲进缝里。
lines.en: Every small fish on the reef dives into a crack.

lines.zh: 我不是自然生成的，是被叫来的。
lines.en: I do not spawn naturally; I am called.

lines.zh: 泥从壳上落下，我睁眼。
lines.en: Mud slides off my shell and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 沙地陷下去一块，正好容下我。
lines.en: The sand sinks into a hollow just my size.

lines.zh: 喙兽已经在旁边等着了。
lines.en: The Beaklings are already waiting beside me.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻水，再抬头。
lines.en: I taste the water first, then lift my head.

lines.zh: 你手里那支海螺，还在响吗。
lines.en: Is that conch in your hand still ringing?

lines.zh: 我从深处上来，带了整片海的重量。
lines.en: I come up from the deep with the whole sea's weight.

lines.zh: 我落地时，海床震了一下。
lines.en: When I settle, the seabed jolts once.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，先看看我有多大。
lines.en: Do not run yet; first see how large I am.

lines.zh: 又一个吹螺的人，站在我面前。
lines.en: Another conch-blower, standing before me.

lines.zh: 海螺的余音还在，我已经到了。
lines.en: The conch's echo has not died, and I am already here.

lines.zh: 我从海草里站起来，比礁还高。
lines.en: I rise from the kelp, taller than the reef.

lines.zh: 先是一阵浑沙，然后是我。
lines.en: First comes a cloud of silt, then me.

lines.zh: 你脚边的沙动了，那是我的背。
lines.en: The sand at your feet shifts; that is my back.

lines.zh: 洞里的水退了一半，给我腾出地方。
lines.en: The water in the cave half drains to make room for me.

lines.zh: 我睁眼的时候，鱼群全散了。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, the fish scatter.

lines.zh: 火在壳上烧，我闻见焦味。
lines.en: Fire burns on my shell; I smell scorching.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出自己的坑。
lines.en: I fall from height and make my own crater.

lines.zh: 我在水里，怎么会淹。
lines.en: I live in water; how would I drown?

lines.zh: 炸开的力道，只让我晃了晃。
lines.en: The blast only makes me sway.

lines.zh: 箭卡在壳缝里，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my seam like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股力量绕开壳，钻进肉里。
lines.en: That force slips past my shell into flesh.

lines.zh: 我几百年没吃，也不差这几天。
lines.en: I have gone centuries unfed; a few days mean nothing.

lines.zh: 雷劈在壳上，麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck my shell and numbed it briefly.

lines.zh: 我往下沉，壳还在响。
lines.en: I sink downward, my shell still ringing.
